subject.title: feat(ui): collapse completed turn work behind a "Worked for X" rollup

question: Should `/verbose full` keep completed-turn work rollups expanded by default?
rationale: Current main treats full verbose as an explicit transcript-visibility preference, while this feature introduces a stronger outer collapse policy; code review cannot choose the permanent precedence without product ownership.

options.title: Honor full verbose
options.body: Keep the outer rollup expanded in full verbose while normal modes default completed turns to collapsed.

options.title: Redefine full verbose
options.body: Allow the outer rollup to remain collapsed and document that full verbose expands only the details inside a manually opened rollup.

options.title: Defer the rollup
options.body: Pause the feature until the transcript-visibility policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Honor full verbose
recommendation.body: Keep the outer rollup expanded in full verbose while normal modes default completed turns to collapsed.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most directly ties this person to the relevant verbosity and expansion behavior.
